# dither-dot - Full Technical & Agentic Documentation

> High-performance in-browser image and animated GIF dithering studio powered by WebAssembly and WebGL shaders.

## Overview
dither-dot is an open-source web application designed for digital artists, game developers, retro computing enthusiasts, and web creators. It brings professional-grade retro dithering and palette quantization directly to the web platform with zero server dependencies.

- Canonical URL: https://dither.xbvuno.dev/
- Studio URL: https://dither.xbvuno.dev/editor/
- Source Code: https://github.com/xbvuno/dither-dot
- License: MIT License (Copyright (c) 2026 Bruno Cerra)

## Technical Architecture
- **Front-End Framework**: React 18 with TypeScript.
- **Build System**: Vite 6.
- **State Management**: Zustand stores (`ditherStore`, `paletteStore`, `paramsStore`, `viewStore`, `watermarkStore`).
- **Core Engine**: `ddot` (Rust) compiled to WebAssembly with SIMD acceleration (`ddot-wasm`).
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS, custom design tokens, monospace font (`Sono`).
- **Web Workers**: Offloads computationally heavy tasks (`ditherWorker`, `paletteWorker`, `gifDecodeWorker`).

## Algorithms Implemented
1. **Error Diffusion**:
   - Floyd-Steinberg (standard 2D error diffusion)
   - Atkinson (classic Apple Mac 1-bit style)
   - Jarvis, Judice, and Ninke (wide distribution matrix)
   - Stucki (crisp high-contrast edges)
   - Burkes (fast integer arithmetic)
   - Sierra-3, Sierra-2, Sierra Lite
2. **Ordered Dithering**:
   - Bayer Matrix 2x2, 4x4, 8x8
   - Halftone Dot Screen (cluster dot printing aesthetic)
   - Blue Noise (uniform high-frequency spatial noise)
3. **Color Reduction & Palette Generation**:
   - Octree Color Quantization
   - Median-Cut Quantization
   - K-Means Clustering (RGB & CIE L*a*b*)

## External Packages
- npm package: [ddot-wasm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ddot-wasm)
- Cargo crate: [ddot-core](https://crates.io/crates/ddot-core)
